blocks.title: The Strix pentest console, inside a Astravia tab
blocks.description: Strix's terminal interface, its sandbox and its 78-skill library - launched from a tab and run on the model you already configured. No second API key.

showcase.assistant_reply: Sandbox up; one critical IDOR filed.

items.title: The screen you know
items.description: Wordmark, launch prompt, model line, trace, sidebar: the CLI's layout and palette, rebuilt for a tab.

items.title: The real toolchain
items.description: nmap, nuclei, ffuf, sqlmap, subfinder, Caido, agent-browser, trivy, gitleaks and trufflehog, inside one container.

items.title: Strix's own skills
items.description: 78 knowledge packs on vulnerabilities, technologies and tooling - loaded before testing starts.

items.title: Your model, no new key
items.description: The console's loop runs on ctx.ai: the model and plan you already picked in Astravia.

items.title: Open the tab
items.description: Strix sits in the tab menu; nothing appears under the conversation until you open it.

items.title: Name a target and press Enter
items.description: A host, URL or local repo becomes the scan target; the rest of the sentence becomes the instruction.

items.title: Watch and read
items.description: Commands run in Strix's sandbox and appear in the trace; each confirmed issue lands in Findings with proof and fix.

blocks.content: Only scan systems you are authorised to test. Strix sends real attack traffic to the targets you give it.
